revisions.goal: Add repository pull-request navigation, overview affordances, and an EVE-native pull-request review page that prioritizes product context while clearly showing merge impact.
revisions.acceptanceCriteria:
- Repository navigation replaces Settings with Pull requests and shows a pull-request count.
- Repository overview shows a ready-to-merge banner when a recent qualifying PR exists.
- Latest snapshot surfaces linked pull-request context only when that snapshot has a PR.
- Pull requests tab lists repository PRs using existing visual patterns and has useful empty/error states.
- Selecting a PR opens a dedicated review page with breadcrumbs back to the repository and linked snapshot.
- PR review defaults to evidence/product context, supports existing code browsing as a secondary view, and clearly communicates what changes on merge.
- UI is responsive, accessible, type-safe, and covered by focused tests.

milestones.title: Data and routing
milestones.goal: Expose pull-request records and route the repository and PR review surfaces.

milestones.title: Repository PR experience
milestones.goal: Add counts, banner, snapshot linkage, and PR list using existing components.

milestones.title: PR review experience
milestones.goal: Build the evidence-first review page with merge-impact summary, breadcrumbs, and secondary code access.

milestones.title: Verification and history
milestones.goal: Run focused/full checks, review the implementation, commit code, and record the EVE Snapshot.
